Q5136.reason: A normal median groove is expected, thrombosed piles hurt, and perianal warts are visible externally, while hard impacted faeces can mimic a rectal mass.

Q5137.reason: Under FRE 703 an expert may base an opinion on x-rays of a type doctors reasonably rely on, so the opinion is admissible even if the films are not in evidence; best-evidence and 'facts not in evidence' objections fail.

Q5142.reason: The Glasgow Coma Scale scores only eye opening, verbal response, and best motor response; pupil response is recorded separately.
